correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction of the triangular orthonormal-basis matrix F_nj=η_n((n+1)/(j+1))^(a/2) for j≤n, Fourier block-phase extraction gives contractive S1 diagonal/subdiagonal projections and necessary sum of block trace norms and adjacent rank-one norms. All earlier-column blocks for each dyadic row have rank one; ratio to its adjacent block remains bounded precisely for a<1 by geometric summability of (j+1)^(-a). Hence finite sum defines an S1 extension and controls norm. Uniform dyadic within-block similarity compares a,b and adjacent norms are comparable to sqrt(|I_k|)||η_I_k||2. Sparse η_{2^{h²}}=(2^{h²}+1)^(-1/2) h^(-5/4) yields S1 at a=0 by sum_h h^-5/4 but not S2 at a=1 since ∑ h^-5/2 H_{2^{h²}+1}=∞. Local finite block checks corroborate but are not the infinite proof.
